committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 20 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing page test has used A$284.11 of the A$600 credit across 46 raw paid clicks, averaging a bit over A$6 a click, with zero conversions recorded in the last 7 days (ads.conversionsLast7=0) and A$261.70 of credit still left.

Click through rate rose to 3.2% from 2.2% even though impressions fell from 1,092 to 689 last week; rank lost to ads share is 73.9% against 20.5% lost to budget, but the test rules keep budget fixed regardless.

Total paid clicks on the test page have reached 46, so the headline, offer and CTAs are frozen past the click-25 mark. The ask_cta_click (question form) has fired 10 times since the test started, review_cta_click (the booking step) still sits at zero.

AI Assistant sessions ticked up to 2 from 1 last week, chatgpt.com is the named source, though this figure undercounts since many AI referrals land in Direct with no referrer. Meanwhile Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, dropped from 18 to 12 sessions.

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, sort these when time allows.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update these to match the current site stats.
